If a player initiates combat, it will drain the player's [[Prayer]] points by half of the current amount, rounded up. If a player is in combat with them over a long period, they will continue to drain the player's Prayer at regular intervals. Wearing a [[spectral spirit shield]] reduces the Prayer drain by half. They can never take away a player's last prayer point. Shadow spiders found in the [[Waterfall Dungeon]] are [[Aggressiveness|unaggressive]] to players with a [[combat level]] of 105 or higher. ==Locations== {{LocTableHead}} {{LocLine |name = Shadow
